about_the_game:
The Last Sanctum is a dark fantasy tactical RPG where memory, spirits, and nightmare intertwine in a dying world.

• You are The Collector—a spirit tuner known only through whispers and fear. Neither alive nor dead, you awaken in the shattered ruins of your sanctum, a vessel of forgotten power, with no memory of who you were or what broke the world.

• To uncover the truth, you must bind wandering spirits, harvest fragments of lost memories, and confront creatures born of fear and sorrow. Every soul carries a piece of the puzzle—every battle brings you closer to the self you lost.

• Explore a vast isometric world scarred by decay. Traverse cursed lands, delve into night-plagued dungeons, and engage in strategic, turn-based combat where unit placement, ability synergy, and resource sacrifice shape the tide of battle.

• Recruit spectral allies, customize their traits, and command a shifting roster of the living and the dead. Use spirit tuning to adapt, combine, and evolve your forces. Each soul you collect strengthens your grip on reality—or pulls you deeper into the void.

• Rebuild the Last Sanctum into a beacon of resistance, unlocking new rituals, upgrades, and memory pathways. Shape your sanctuary with choices that affect the world, the spirits, and your own fragmented fate.

This is not a tale of vengeance or conquest—

It is a journey through oblivion, memory, and sacrifice.

To remember is to survive.

To survive is to save what remains.

This is The Last Sanctum.

content_descriptors.notes: This game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 - 64bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 / Intel i5 7400
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon™ RX 580 / GEFORCE GTX 1070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: System requirements are subject to change as the game is still in development.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 - 64bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 5700x / Intel i7 9700K
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon™ RX 5600 / GEFORCE RTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: System requirements are subject to change as the game is still in development.

short_description: A dark fantasy tactical RPG, a forsaken necromancer, raise an army of the damned to reclaim your sanctum. Explore an open, isometric world, conquer cursed dungeons, recruit souls, and master team-based, turn-based combat in a decaying realm.
